reader_summary.overview: We enter the wayback machine and revisit the subject of Acquired’s second ever episode. Together with Kevin and Mike, Emily helped build Instagram's business model, which today accounts for nearly 1/4 of all of Facebook’s revenue. Is this still Acquired’s canonical A+ with an extra 3.5 years of hindsight?
